## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested enhancement.

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution / Architectural Feasibility
Describe the solution you'd like. Keep in mind that KeplerBridge is strictly bounded to Feature Level 11_0 hardware (no DXR, no Mesh Shaders, no Tier 3 bindless) and must maintain zero third-party dependencies.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code snippets, or diagrams about the feature request here.
